decisions.reason: As a long-established German finishing-equipment wholesaler, the firm is likely to persist with this core perfect-binding offer because it fits its announced direction and installed-service logic, even if the evidence on recent promotion is thin.
The fully automatic perfect binder matches the firm's stated push toward automation especially closely, so prior commitment and strategic fit make withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

This booklet maker remains close to the firm's core digital print finishing business, and management influenced by escalation of commitment would tend to retain it unless there were clear signs of sustained failure, which are not shown here.
